info.name: BusyBuddy
info.description:
BusyBuddy_v2 API collection.

Two folders:

1. **Front Store API** - the storefront-facing backend endpoints served by the BusyBuddy Shopify app (web/backend/routes/frontStore). These are hit by storefront visitors through a Shopify **App Proxy**, so every request carries `shop` + `signature` query params that the app verifies with HMAC-SHA256 over all sorted query params (see web/middleware/verify-signature.js). Postman cannot mint a real Shopify App Proxy signature, so these requests are documented for shape/reference; against a live server they return `401 Invalid request signature` unless a valid signed `shop`/`signature` pair is supplied.

2. **Email (shared pipeline)** - calls the shared Agent Ops orchestrator `/email` endpoint directly (the same pipeline the `.github/workflows/email.yml` caller reaches through the reusable workflow). Auth is the orchestrator shared secret sent as a header.

Uses variables `{{baseUrl}}`, `{{orchestratorUrl}}`, `{{sharedSecret}}`, `{{shop}}` - no secrets are hardcoded.

item.name: Front Store API
item.description: Storefront endpoints mounted at `/api/frontStore` (web/backend/routes/frontStore/index.js), each behind `requireSubscriptionAccess`. Reached via Shopify **App Proxy**: Shopify appends `shop`, `signature`, `timestamp`, etc. to the query string and signs them. The app verifies with `verifySHA256` (HMAC-SHA256 of all sorted `key=value` query params, excluding `signature`, keyed by `SHOPIFY_API_SECRET`). Requests without a valid signature get `401 { message: 'Invalid request signature...' }`. Set `{{shop}}` to the myshopify domain; a real `signature` must be generated by Shopify's proxy - Postman requests here are for documentation and will 401 on a live server.

query.description: Shopify numeric product id the storefront is currently viewing
Shopify App Proxy HMAC-SHA256 over all sorted query params

request.description: Returns the highest-priority ACTIVE, in-schedule bundle containing `product_id`, enriched with Shopify product data. Returns `{ bundles: [] }` when none match or the plan feature for the bundle type is not accessible.

Returns the shop's inactive-tab (browser tab) message content: `{ status: 'SUCCESS', data: {...}|null }`. Returns `data: null` when disabled, out of its schedule window, or the plan feature is not accessible.

Returns the active announcement bar for the shop: `{ status: 'SUCCESS', data: {...}|null }`. Enforces the merchant's schedule window; resolves a themed background SVG URL when `selectedTheme` is not 'solid'. `400 { status: false, message: 'Shop not found' }` if the shop has no Shop document.

Subscribes a storefront visitor's email to the shop's configured email provider list (tagged `announcement-bar`, `bar-<id>`). Body: `email` (required, validated), `announcementBarId` (required), `listId` (optional; falls back to the bar's or provider's default list). Responses: `200 { success: true, message }`, `400` invalid email / no list / provider not configured, `404` shop or bar not found.

item.name: Email (shared pipeline)
item.description: Calls the shared Agent Ops orchestrator directly: `POST {{orchestratorUrl}}/email`. Auth is the orchestrator shared secret, sent as the `x-orchestrator-secret` header (value `{{sharedSecret}}`). This is the same pipeline BusyBuddy reaches from CI through `.github/workflows/email.yml` -> agent-ops `email-reusable.yml`. Supports Gmail or Mailchimp, single or many recipients, and either direct `text`/`html` content or a named `template` with `template_vars`.

request.description: Send a single Gmail message with direct text content.
Send one Gmail message to many recipients (array form of `to`; a comma-separated string is also accepted by the pipeline).
Send a single Mailchimp message with direct HTML content.
Render and send a named template with variables instead of direct content. `template_vars` is a JSON object substituted into the template.

body.raw:
{ "provider": "gmail", "to": "person@example.com", "subject": "Both parts", "text": "Plain-text fallback for clients that do not render HTML.", "html": "

Rich HTML body.

" }

request.description: Direct-content mode supplying both `text` and `html` in one message (multipart/alternative).
Missing required fields (no `to`, and no content or template). Expected: `400` validation error. Auth header is present and valid, so this exercises request-body validation, not auth.
Wrong/missing `x-orchestrator-secret`. Expected: `401` unauthorized. The body is otherwise valid, isolating the auth failure.
